Graduate Studies
Welcome
Welcome to the Graduate Programs in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics!
If you are already a graduate student in our Department, I hope you will find the information provided here useful. Graduate study is a time of opportunities and freedom to challenge yourself; I encourage you to embrace these opportunities so that you can grow, not only as mathematicians or statisticians, but also as professionals and citizens. As part of this process, you will take graduate courses, engage in novel research and educate others. Other enriching activities include attending (and presenting) seminars; participating in outreach activities; and taking advantage of career preparation sessions.
If you are not our graduate student (yet), I hope the information here will inspire you to apply to one of our graduate programs. We always look for bright, enthusiastic candidates who can enrich our Department.
If you want to find out more, do not hesitate to contact us.
Bartek Protas,
Department Chair
Graduate Study in Mathematics & Statistics
The Department of Mathematics and Statistics at McMaster offers the following graduate programs:
M.Sc. in Mathematics
M.Sc. in Statistics
Ph.D. in Mathematics
Ph.D. in Statistics
Please see the Graduate Student Handbook for full information about our program offerings.

Accessibility
If you require any content on this website in an alternate format, please contact us at mathstat@mcmaster.ca and we will respond as promptly as possible. If you have an accommodation need for a planned meeting, event, or interview, including alternative formats or communication supports, please e-mail or call us to make the appropriate arrangements.
If there is an AODA web accessibility issue with this website, please report it to Media Production Services using our AODA bug reporting form.
